svg.title: Tuned c128 profile kernel-duration shares
svg.desc: Rank-zero CUDA kernel durations in a tuned c128 Torch profile sum to 163.8 milliseconds. FlashInfer MNNVL AllReduce is 65.4 milliseconds or 40 percent, DeepGEMM FP8 GEMMs 35.9 milliseconds or 21.9 percent, NCCL AllGather 10.4 milliseconds or 6.4 percent, sparse MLA 7.6 milliseconds or 4.6 percent, and other kernels 44.5 milliseconds or 27.1 percent. Overlapping kernels mean these shares are not wall-clock shares.
